title: Predicting Juror Predisposition Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Study of Human and Algorithmic Jury Selection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the predictive accuracy of machine learning models (Random Forest and KNN) compared to human jury consultants. While it includes a section on 'Ethical and Legal Considerations' and discusses fairness/discrimination in a legal context, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as its primary research component.
